title: GET /tournaments/:id/board-prizes response
description: The board prizes of a team event (contract revision 5), as the Team sheets page ranks them: points first. `?min_games=n` sets the minimum number of games on a board; absent, the desk's default. The desk roles only. Refusals (error.schema.json): 409 not_team_event, 403 arbiter_role, 404 as for any tournament route.
